jobs.description_text: 岗位职责 面向车道线、道路边界、路面标识、交通标志及其他静态道路设施，研发多帧融合、跨视角关联、几何与语义联合优化算法，提升标注精度、完整性及空间一致性。 利用离线全序列信息，结合高精度定位、SLAM、三维重建及视觉基础模型，提升复杂场景、遮挡区域和长尾要素的自动化处理能力。 建立静态数据的质量标准、评测体系与问题归因机制，推动自动质检、置信度评估、人工复核及难例回流，形成可持续迭代的数据生产闭环。 推动算法从原型验证走向规模化生产，持续优化计算效率、资源消耗和处理稳定性，平衡数据质量、生产成本与交付时效。 任职要求 计算机、自动化、电子工程、机器人、数学等相关专业硕士及以上学历，或具备同等水平的相关实践经验。 具备扎实的计算机视觉、三维几何与机器学习基础，在自动驾驶感知、自动标注、三维重建或地图生产等领域具有深入研发经验。 熟悉多视角几何、多传感器融合、点云处理、语义分割、目标检测、矢量化表达等技术中的多项，并能够针对实际数据问题设计完整方案。 熟悉相机与激光雷达标定、时空同步及定位误差对数据质量的影响，具备跨模块分析和定位问题的能力。 熟练使用 Python、C++ 中至少一种语言，熟悉主流深度学习框架，具备算法部署、性能分析及大规模数据处理经验。 有主导复杂算法项目落地的经历，能够制定技术路线、评估关键风险，并通过量化指标验证改进效果。 具备良好的跨团队沟通能力，能够将业务需求转化为清晰的算法目标、数据规范及交付标准。 加分项 有静态场景自动标注、离线感知、高精地图或 BEV 数据生产的量产项目经验。 有视觉基础模型、半监督学习、主动学习或模型辅助标注的实际应用经验。 有复杂路口、异形道路、施工区域等长尾场景的算法优化经验。 有云端 GPU 计算优化、分布式推理或大规模离线算法生产经验。

jobs.description_text: We are seeking an Embodied AI Engineer to enable the successful deployment of humanoid robots in industrial environments. Rather than developing the robot's core locomotion or control algorithms, this role focuses on adapting, configuring, and optimizing commercially available humanoid robot platforms for customer-specific applications with core competences in Embodied AI. You will work at the intersection of robotics, AI, perception, and industrial automation, transforming generic robot capabilities into reliable, production-ready workflows through algorithm tuning, application development, and system integration. Key Responsibilities Application Development Develop robotic applications for industrial PoC and pilot projects. Configure humanoid robot behaviors for customer-specific workflows. Design and optimize task execution pipelines for material handling, inspection, logistics, assembly, and other industrial use cases. Integrate robot capabilities with customer production systems and external equipment. Algorithm Adaptation & Optimization Fine-tune perception, manipulation, and task-planning algorithms to improve application performance. Optimize object detection, pose estimation, grasp planning, navigation parameters, and task sequencing. Configure AI models, perception pipelines, and robot behavior parameters to meet customer requirements. Improve system robustness, repeatability, and task success rates through iterative testing and validation. AI & Robotics Integration Integrate robot SDKs, ROS2 packages, vision systems, and AI frameworks. Develop interfaces between humanoid robots, AI services, MES/WMS systems, and industrial automation equipment. Support deployment of multimodal AI, LLM-based task planning, and intelligent robot workflows where applicable. Validation & Deployment Conduct factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and customer trials. Analyze field data and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Collaborate with robot platform vendors to resolve software and integration issues. Support onsite commissioning and technical troubleshooting. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in robotics software, AI applications, or robot deployment. Experience with ROS or ROS2. Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++. Understanding of robot perception, manipulation, and task planning. Familiarity with computer vision, machine learning, or AI model deployment. Strong analytical and debugging skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience deploying humanoid, mobile, or collaborative robots. Experience with perception frameworks such as OpenCV, YOLO, or other deep learning-based vision systems. Familiarity with robot SDKs and motion planning frameworks (e.g., MoveIt). Experience integrating AI models, LLMs, or vision-language models into robotic applications. Experience working in manufacturing or industrial automation environments. Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, or EtherCAT. Core Competencies Robotics Application Development Embodied AI Deployment Perception & Manipulation Optimization Robot Behavior Configuration AI Workflow Integration Industrial Solution Delivery Customer-Centric Problem Solving

jobs.description_text: Job Summary As an AI Expert in RBCD/TEF3, you will be the technical driver of equipment-centric enterprise AI in BBM-CN — designing, deploying, and applying AI where it creates measurable value: on and around our manufacturing equipment. You will work deep inside the factory, side-by-side with equipment, maintenance, and operations teams, identifying real problems at the machine and solving them end-to-end with AI. You own your deployment strategy: prioritising use cases by business value and feasibility — from predictive maintenance and anomaly detection to machine-integrated vision and LLM-based shop-floor assistance — always on a rock-solid technical foundation in machine learning, industrial data, and edge deployment, and aligned with Bosch enterprise AI platforms (e.g., M.AI.Co) and the plant’s IIoT and edge infrastructure. For you, AI is never the goal: every project starts from a real problem on the shop floor and ends with a measured, sustainable improvement in daily production. Roles and Responsibilities Equipment-Centric AI Strategy & Deployment Define and continuously refine the TEF3 AI strategy and roadmap for equipment and manufacturing technology — prioritising use cases by business value, data feasibility, and scalability, aligned with plant and PS/CE direction. Translate equipment pain points (downtime, scrap, cycle time, energy, maintenance cost) into clearly scoped AI use cases with quantified targets and business cases. Drive end-to-end deployment: from single-line pilot to plant-wide rollout and multi-plant replication, with defined acceptance criteria, KPI tracking, and sustainable handover to operations and maintenance. Cooperate with PS central departments and other plants to deploy standard AI solutions for equipment and to feed proven TEF3 solutions back into the standard portfolio. AI Application Development on the Shop Floor Develop and deploy AI applications that solve concrete equipment problems: predictive maintenance (failure prediction, remaining useful life), anomaly detection on machine and process signals, process parameter optimisation, OEE improvement, and maintenance / spare-parts planning support. Develop computer-vision solutions for equipment-integrated quality and condition monitoring (e.g., on-machine inspection, AOI support). Build LLM-based applications that genuinely help the shop floor: retrieval-augmented assistants over equipment manuals, fault codes, and work instructions — applied where they clearly beat simpler solutions. Work directly at the machine with maintenance and equipment teams: observe, measure, and validate that solutions address root causes rather than symptoms. Industrial Data & Deployment Foundation Design and implement industrial data pipelines: machine data acquisition (PLC, CNC, sensors via OPC UA / MQTT / fieldbus), edge processing, and historian / IIoT platform integration, ensuring data quality and governance at the source. Deploy AI on industrial edge devices and on-prem infrastructure: model optimisation (quantisation, ONNX, TensorRT), containerised serving, and robust integration into equipment environments. Establish MLOps practices for equipment AI: monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and full lifecycle management in production. Ensure IT/OT security and functional-safety requirements are respected in every deployment on and around equipment. Leadership, Scaling & Knowledge Sharing Lead or accompany cross-functional project teams (equipment, maintenance, production, quality, IT) with full responsibility for costs, quality, and on-time delivery. Coach equipment and maintenance engineers in data and AI literacy; build pragmatic, lasting AI competence within TEF3. Monitor AI technology developments (foundation models, agentic frameworks, edge AI) and evaluate them soberly against real TEF3 use cases — adopting what solves problems, not what is fashionable. Authority (mandatory for Grade 7 and above, optional for others) Define the AI deployment strategy and roadmap for equipment-centric AI within RBCD/TEF3 scope, with full responsibility for results. Lead AI projects and work packages cross-functionally; select technical approaches and tools within approved budgets. Cooperate with PS central departments to deploy and share standard solutions across plants. Coach and guide data enthusiasts and team members, supporting their competency build-up. Qualifications Requirement Master’s degree (or above) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Electrical / Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field; exceptional Bachelor candidates with a strong delivery record will also be considered. 3+ years of hands-on experience in real AI/ML projects, including responsibility for deploying AI solutions in an industrial or manufacturing environment (equipment, maintenance, or production-technology domain is a strong plus). Proven track record of solving real problems: AI solutions delivered from prototype to serial production with measurable business impact (uptime, scrap, cost, energy). Strong proactive, self-driven learning mindset with a customer-oriented and CIP (Continuous Improvement) attitude; willingness to spend substantial time on the shop floor. Job Relevant Knowledge and Experience AI & Machine Learning Engineering Expert in Python; proficient in PyTorch and/or TensorFlow/Keras and scikit-learn. Strong in time-series machine learning on machine / process data: forecasting, anomaly detection, failure prediction; solid applied-statistics and signal-processing fundamentals. Proficient in computer vision: OpenCV (filtering, feature extraction, camera calibration) and detection / segmentation models (YOLO, Faster-RCNN, SAM) applied to industrial inspection tasks. Hands-on LLM application engineering: RAG (vector databases, embedding pipelines, context management), prompt engineering, tool-calling; awareness of agentic patterns and frameworks (LangGraph, MCP) — applied selectively where they add real value. Familiar with data labelling toolchains and data versioning (Label Studio, CVAT, DVC, MLflow). Equipment & Industrial Domain Knowledge Understanding of manufacturing equipment and automation: PLC/CNC, robotics, drives, sensors, and industrial communication (OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet/EtherCAT). Familiar with equipment and maintenance processes: TPM, condition monitoring, spare-parts management, OEE, MTBF/MTTR; able to turn failure modes and maintenance records into data problems. Experience with industrial data infrastructure: historians, IIoT platforms, and edge computing in production environments. Structured problem-solving methods (8D, DMAIC, PDCA); Six Sigma certification is a plus. Deployment, MLOps & Edge Engineering Proficient in Git and CI/CD pipelines for ML/AI systems; containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) for model serving. Model optimisation for edge deployment: quantisation, ONNX, TensorRT. MLOps practices: experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B), model registry, monitoring, and drift management. Familiar with cloud / on-prem ML platforms (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, or equivalent); IT/OT security awareness. Domain & Soft Skills Ability to go deep into the factory: observe real processes, talk to operators and maintainers, and translate ambiguous shop-floor pain into well-scoped, valuable AI solutions. jobs.description_text: 负责智能驾驶/ADAS 多传感器标定算法的设计、开发、优化与落地，包括相机内外参标定、相机-车辆标定、Camera-LiDAR 联合标定、多相机标定、EOL产线标定等。 负责标定算法核心模块的开发、优化及工程化实现。 负责标定算法的精度、鲁棒性和收敛性能优化，并针对实际道路及车辆运行场景进行算法分析和改进。 负责算法从数据分析、算法开发到实车测试和量产部署的落地。 1. 基础要求 计算机、自动化、电子信息、车辆工程、数学、控制、机器人等相关专业，硕士及以上学历； 具有计算机视觉、机器人、自动驾驶、SLAM、三维点云或多传感器融合相关项目2年以上经验； 2. 算法能力 熟悉相机标定、坐标系变换及三维几何基础，掌握旋转矩阵、四元数、Euler Angle 等姿态表示方法； 熟悉计算机视觉及三维几何算法，如 Optical Flow、特征匹配、PnP、RANSAC、Homography、Vanishing Point、ICP/GICP 等； 熟悉非线性优化及 Ceres、g2o 等优化框架，具备标定算法精度、鲁棒性和收敛性分析能力。 3. 工程能力 熟悉 C/C++、Python 及 Linux 开发环境，具备良好的代码实现、调试和性能优化能力； 熟悉 OpenCV、PCL、Eigen、Ceres 等常用算法库，具备算法模块工程化和量产部署经验； 具备较强的数据分析和问题定位能力，能够结合实际数据、日志及实车测试结果进行算法迭代和优化。 加分项 具有智能驾驶/ADAS 量产项目开发经验； 具有 Camera、LiDAR等多传感器标定经验； 具有实际车辆道路测试及标定问题分析经验； 具备 AI 辅助编程实践经验，熟悉 GitHub Copilot、OpenAI Codex 等工具，能够利用 AI 提升算法开发、调试和代码重构效率； 具有嵌入式/车载平台算法部署及 CPU性能优化经验。
